narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Myth -> Mechanism Explanation -> Conclusion & Recommendation
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To debunk the popular dermatological myth that shaving hair makes it grow back thicker. The video uses anatomical animations and professional explanation to clarify that shaving only cuts the hair at its thickest part near the surface, not affecting the follicle.
